items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Well, he and I were in the same music class.

ctx.x: I was doing Jonah not so long ago, and Jonah would sing about Stuff, that Stuff would call -- the this bus would blow the horn and stuff and he'd tell you, C-sharp and anything, everything he would hear, every time he'd call it.
Like Henry Coker, the trombone plaver?
